arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY month ORDER BY transaction_count ASC, month ASC LIMIT 3
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions in each calendar month and returns the three months with the fewest, fewest first.
assumptions: Counts all transactions, labelled or not, including negative amounts and those with errors.
Data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so only January to October 2019 are compared.
Months with equal counts are ordered by month.
